desc: Derive and verify the prefix-displacement formulation for the location of smoke emitted at each generation time.
Determine the exact condition under which new smoke is generated at the origin after each wind movement.
Implement the one-pass hash-set algorithm and establish update/query ordering for each time step.
Validate the implementation on provided samples and edge cases involving revisiting coordinates and unreachable targets.
Produce the final Python program with stdin parsing and output construction in expected \(O(N)\) time and memory.
